term: part of a self-mover (PartOf p x)
definition: PartOf p x: p is an integral part of the whole x, as the soul-moved limb, or the part that moves, of an animal that moves itself (Physics VIII.4, 254b27-33; VIII.5). It is parthood of a body or living whole, not set membership, not a logical part and not a metaphysical component such as essence or esse. In Lean a parameter B → B → Prop with no mereological axioms: distinctness of the moving part from the whole is stated in STMT-SELF-MOVER-MOVES-BY-A-DISTINCT-PART, not built into PartOf.
note: Stipulative analyst notion, attribution deferred. Its constraints are STMT-SELF-MOVER-MOVES-BY-A-DISTINCT-PART and STMT-WHOLE-IN-ACT-THROUGH-ITS-PART. A source would be Physics VIII.5, 257b-258a (the self-mover divides into an unmoved moving part and a moved part), which is not pinned.
